name: What unique insurance considerations are there for oceanfront condos in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What unique insurance considerations are there for oceanfront condos in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Oceanfront condos in South Florida require specific insurance coverage due to their location. While the HOA typically covers the building's exterior and common areas (master policy), individual unit owners need a 'walls-in' policy (HO6) to cover the interior of their unit, personal belongings, and liability. Flood insurance is often mandatory and separate from a standard hurricane policy. It's crucial to understand what the master policy covers and what your individual policy needs to cover, particularly regarding hurricane deductibles and wind damage. Consulting with a local insurance specialist is a key preparation step to ensure adequate coverage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Oceanfront condos need 'walls-in' (HO6) policies for unit interiors and flood insurance, in addition to the HOA's master policy. Hurricane deductibles are also a key consideration.
